summary: Resolved decision gate DG-8 with a new ADR-011 (Jellyfin Enhanced Coexistence Policy) in docs/decisions.md and added the coexistence policy plus tests. Per the user's resolved decision, ArrTags does NOT implement automatic duplicate/overlap detection or suppression and does NOT depend on Jellyfin Enhanced internals; Jellyfin Enhanced chooses its own overlay placement, so overlap handling is deferred to the user, and ArrTags badge output is controlled only by the existing configuration (the BadgeMoviePosters/BadgeEpisodePosters poster enable flags and RendererConfiguration.Selectors). Enhanced's Spoiler Guard has no material effect on ArrTags badge display, so ArrTags renders its derived badge normally and adds no special spoiler/hidden handling or Enhanced filter-ordering dependency. No production code, RenderVersion, renderer behavior, configuration schema, or existing ADR was changed; ADR-011 is the only ADR added. Authoritative docs were aligned: docs/architecture.md section 10 states the policy (and the configuration section records that no separate coexistence field is persisted), section 13 integration testing, section 14 item 8, and section 6; PLANS.md DG-8 row, task 5.10 checkbox and status paragraph, Milestone 5 status row, the Enhanced acceptance criterion, the Phase 5 deliverable, and the Enhanced risk mitigation; docs/implementation-readiness.md status, basis, Former Action Disposition item 10, the implementation-time question, a new Resolved DG-8 section, and Ready-for-Implementation; docs/data-model.md enhancedCoexistencePolicy rows and prose; docs/changelog.md Task 5.10 section; and README.md status, Phase 5 bullet, test totals, and next tasks. New tests in tests/ArrTags.Tests/EnhancedCoexistenceTests.cs (7 cases) are genuinely meaningful and run without a live host, live Enhanced install, or the Skia native runtime: they assert (1) the production assembly references no Enhanced assembly, (2) it declares no Enhanced/spoiler/suppression type, (3) the policy surface (PluginConfiguration, PluginConfigurationSnapshot, RendererConfiguration, MediaEligibility, BadgeSelectorResolver, RenderRequest, RenderFingerprintInput, RenderOutputPolicy, ArtworkGenerationRequest, ArtworkPublicationRequest) exposes no Enhanced/spoiler/hidden/blur/suppress/overlap member, (4) the renderer/publication reason enums have no suppression branch, (5) Movie/Episode poster eligibility varies only with the existing poster flags (Series/Season are never surfaces), (6) renderer badge selection varies only with the existing selector enablement, and (7) the real SkiaBadgeRenderer decision is a pure function of the canonical RenderRequest (identical repeated pass-through decisions for SourceUnavailable, NoMetadata, and IneligibleSurface) with no hidden global state. No fake Enhanced dependency was added and no new configuration knob was introduced.

known_limitations: No production code was changed because the resolved decision requires none: the existing poster enable flags and renderer selector enablement already provide the user control the decision relies on, and no Enhanced-internals coupling existed to remove. No new configuration knob was invented.

The publisher is covered structurally rather than by a new behavioral orchestration test: ArtworkPublicationRequest and the publication/reconciliation reason enums are inspected for Enhanced/spoiler/hidden/suppression members, and publication eligibility is behaviorally proven to vary only with the poster flags. There is no Enhanced or spoiler input to vary against, and the existing publisher orchestration tests already establish its deterministic output; adding a duplicate fake-host harness would not test the coexistence claim.

The tests prove the absence of an Enhanced reference/type/member and of a spoiler/hidden/overlap suppression branch in the compiled production surface; they cannot prove a hypothetical future string-based dynamic dependency, but no such mechanism exists in the current code.

No live Jellyfin Enhanced installation or standard image route was exercised; confirming ArrTags output through the standard server image response path with Enhanced present remains task 5.11, which is explicitly out of scope for 5.10.
This task resolves only DG-8; it does not implement Phase 6 queue/event/caching wiring or the task 5.11 route/client tests.
